project: Live public demo API QA practice
environment: Actual HTTPS requests from this computer to the publicly hosted DummyJSON demo API; no local server or substituted fixture responses.
scope: Read-only functional and negative testing. No production or company experience is claimed. Not load or security testing.
schema_validation: Passed Postman Collection v2.1 schema using ajv-draft-04.

cases.title: Retrieve one existing product
cases.expected: HTTP 200; JSON object with id 1, a non-empty title, a non-negative numeric price, and a category.

response_body.title: Essence Mascara Lash Princess
response_body.description: The Essence Mascara Lash Princess is a popular mascara known for its volumizing and lengthening effects. Achieve dramatic lashes with this long-lasting and cruelty-free formula.

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. Product ID 1; title "Essence Mascara Lash Princess"; price 9.99; category beauty.

cases.title: Limit the first page and select fields
cases.expected: HTTP 200; three products, skip 0, limit 3; each product has only id, title and price.

assertions.name: Selected fields and identity only are returned

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. 3 products; skip 0; limit 3; IDs 1, 2, 3; returned keys id, title, price.

cases.title: Skip the first three product fixtures
cases.expected: HTTP 200; three products, skip 3, limit 3; IDs 1, 2, 3 are excluded; no duplicate IDs.
cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. 3 products; skip 3; limit 3; returned IDs 4, 5, 6.

cases.title: Search for a known product keyword
cases.expected: HTTP 200; non-empty results; returned product text matches mascara and IDs are unique.

products.title: Essence Mascara Lash Princess
products.description: The Essence Mascara Lash Princess is a popular mascara known for its volumizing and lengthening effects. Achieve dramatic lashes with this long-lasting and cruelty-free formula.

assertions.name: Search returns at least one product
Every result contains the search keyword
Result count agrees with returned search page

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. 1 result(s), total 1; titles: Essence Mascara Lash Princess.

cases.title: Search with a keyword that has no matches
cases.expected: HTTP 200; products is an empty array; total is 0 and skip is 0. A valid search with no results is not a missing endpoint.

assertions.name: Empty result starts at offset zero

cases.title: Filter products by category
cases.expected: HTTP 200; non-empty products array; every returned product belongs to beauty; IDs are unique.

products.title: Essence Mascara Lash Princess
products.description: The Essence Mascara Lash Princess is a popular mascara known for its volumizing and lengthening effects. Achieve dramatic lashes with this long-lasting and cruelty-free formula.

products.title: Eyeshadow Palette with Mirror
products.description: The Eyeshadow Palette with Mirror offers a versatile range of eyeshadow shades for creating stunning eye looks. With a built-in mirror, it's convenient for on-the-go makeup application.

products.title: Powder Canister
products.description: The Powder Canister is a finely milled setting powder designed to set makeup and control shine. With a lightweight and translucent formula, it provides a smooth and matte finish.

products.title: Red Lipstick
products.description: The Red Lipstick is a classic and bold choice for adding a pop of color to your lips. With a creamy and pigmented formula, it provides a vibrant and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Red Nail Polish
products.description: The Red Nail Polish offers a rich and glossy red hue for vibrant and polished nails. With a quick-drying formula, it provides a salon-quality finish at home.

assertions.name: Category total covers the returned page

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. 5 products; all categories beauty; total 5.

cases.title: Sort products by ascending price
cases.expected: HTTP 200; five products; numeric prices in non-decreasing order, including equal prices as valid.

assertions.name: Prices are sorted in ascending order
Sorting preserves the requested page size

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. Prices in returned order: 0.79, 0.99, 0.99, 1.29, 1.49; limit 5.

cases.title: Retrieve category names for filter controls
cases.expected: HTTP 200; non-empty array of unique non-empty strings; documented example category beauty is included.

assertions.name: Category list is a non-empty array
Each category is a non-empty string

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 200. 24 unique category names; beauty is present.

cases.title: Reject a non-existent product identifier
cases.expected: HTTP 404; JSON object with a non-empty message; no product id, title, or price fields.

assertions.name: A readable JSON error message is returned
Missing resource is not returned as a product

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 404. Error message: Product with id '999999' not found.

cases.title: Reject access to current user without a token
cases.expected: HTTP 401; JSON error with a non-empty message; no user identity or access token in the body.

assertions.name: No authenticated user or token is disclosed

cases.actual_summary: HTTP 401. Error message: Access Token is required.
